name: MLI-NeRF
definition: A two-stage method to learn an intrinsic-aware NeRF that integrates multiple light information, enabling novel view synthesis (NVS), relighting, and intrinsic decomposition (reflectance/shading separation) without statistical priors.
summary: MLI-NeRF is a two-stage optimization procedure that learns an intrinsic-aware Neural Radiance Field for novel view synthesis, relighting, and intrinsic decomposition without relying on statistical priors or ground-truth intrinsic labels.
